description: Imports and Exports Control Department - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No.9 of 2024.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations promulgated under the Imports and Exports Control Act, No. 1 of 1969, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically amends import control regulations, modifies HS code classifications for various goods (including agricultural products and unmanned aircraft), and establishes new import control license fees. The content focuses on regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for import/export control, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel/structure matters.
